description: Will the lifts run? A 48-hour operating-risk estimate from the Open-Meteo forecast — wind-hold (gusts), visibility, cold (wind-chill), and heavy-snow control delays. Modeled guidance, NOT the resort's own operating decision — always check live lift status.

resort.description: Same as `slug`: the resort slug or name. Pass either one.

slug.description: Resort slug or name, e.g. "portillo" or "Portillo". Required unless `resort` is given.

name: get_operating_risk

markdown.description: Human-readable markdown summary of the tool result (may be omitted when structuredContent carries a typed payload; content[0].text always has the prose).

title: Lift-operation risk
